name: Gene fusion
author: Jude Gomila
message: Editing pass: every TL;DR and summary stands alone

fields.before: "Two genes broken and joined together, creating a hybrid protein that can drive cancer. Often exquisitely drug-sensitive."
fields.after: "A gene fusion is two genes broken and joined together, creating a hybrid protein that can drive cancer. Fusion-driven cancers are often exquisitely drug-sensitive."
